vijay-nagar.name: Vijay Nagar
vijay-nagar.about:
Vijay Nagar is a large suburb in the east of Indore, planned and developed by the Indore Development Authority, and it grew quickly from the late 1990s. It sits between MR-9, MR-10 and the Eastern Ring Road, with AB Road running through it, and today it doubles as one of the city's main commercial hubs. Homes range from older IDA flats and plotted houses to newer apartment societies, with numbered IDA schemes such as 54, 74 and 78 around it.

Vijay Nagar Chauraha is a station on the Indore Metro Yellow Line, on the stretch that opened for regular service in September 2026, so a tutor coming along the Super Corridor or MR-10 side can use the metro and walk or take an auto for the last part. In apartment societies the tutor is usually registered at the gate once, while in plotted lanes they reach the doorstep directly. AB Road and the main squares get busy in the evening shopping hours, so an early evening slot is easier to keep regular. Many students add online sessions with a specialist. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

scheme-54.name: Scheme No. 54
scheme-54.about:
Scheme No. 54 is one of the Indore Development Authority's numbered schemes and forms part of Vijay Nagar, sharing its postcode. It is laid out in sectors with plotted houses, IDA housing and apartment buildings, and it also holds a good share of Vijay Nagar's shops, offices and hotels. Meghdoot Garden, a large public garden, lies within the scheme and gives its name to the nearby metro station.

Meghdoot Garden and Vijay Nagar Chauraha are both stations on the Indore Metro Yellow Line, which began regular service through this stretch in September 2026. Tutors coming from the Super Corridor, MR-10 or Sukhliya side can ride the metro and finish the trip on foot or by auto. In independent houses a tutor can usually go straight to the door, while apartment buildings may keep a register, and parking on busy commercial lanes can take time. Evenings around the Vijay Nagar square are crowded, so a class that starts a little before the rush tends to run more smoothly. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

scheme-74.name: Scheme No. 74
scheme-74.about:
Scheme No. 74, including the Scheme 74-C area, is an Indore Development Authority layout on the Vijay Nagar side of the city, under the Vijay Nagar postcode. It is known for parks and greenery, with residential plots and independent houses alongside some apartment buildings. Scheme No. 78, Scheme No. 114 and the main Vijay Nagar area are its neighbours.

Because most homes here are independent houses on planned sector roads, a tutor usually reaches the door directly and parking is simpler than in the busier commercial blocks of Vijay Nagar. The nearest metro stations are on the Yellow Line through Vijay Nagar, so a tutor using the metro will normally finish the trip by auto. The shopping streets and hotels of Vijay Nagar are close by, and the main roads fill up in the evening, so families often choose a slot just after school hours. For senior classes, many parents combine a nearby home tutor with online help from a specialist. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

scheme-78.name: Scheme No. 78
scheme-78.about:
Scheme No. 78 is an Indore Development Authority scheme in the Vijay Nagar area, arranged in sectors and slices, with the Aranya Nagar pocket inside it. The housing is mainly plotted independent houses and IDA-built homes, with some newer apartment buildings. Its neighbours include Vijay Nagar, Scheme No. 74 and Scheme No. 114, and the Dewas Naka side of AB Road lies to the north.

Laxmibai Nagar railway station is the nearest suburban rail point, and the Indore Metro Yellow Line runs through Vijay Nagar, so tutors travelling from further away usually combine a train or metro ride with an auto. In the plotted sectors a tutor goes straight to the door, which makes short weekday classes easy to arrange. Heavy vehicles and evening traffic build up on the roads towards Dewas Naka, so timings are worth planning around those hours. Families wanting board exam or entrance preparation often add online sessions with a subject specialist. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

scheme-114.name: Scheme No. 114
scheme-114.about:
Scheme No. 114 is a planned Indore Development Authority area on the Vijay Nagar side of the city. It has a mix of apartment buildings and plotted houses and is described by property portals as an upscale residential pocket. Scheme No. 78, Scheme No. 74 and the MR-11 area are its neighbours, and AB Road is close by.

Laxmibai Nagar and Mangliya Gaon are the nearest railway stations, and the metro stations in Vijay Nagar are the closest Yellow Line points, so a tutor coming by public transport usually takes an auto for the final stretch. In apartment buildings a tutor is registered with the guard once, while in the plotted lanes they reach the door directly. The roads linking to AB Road get busy in the evening, so fixing a steady weekday time helps. Students in higher classes often pair a local tutor with online sessions for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sukhliya.name: Sukhliya
sukhliya.about:
Sukhliya was a rural area before the 1990s and was developed by the Indore Municipal Corporation and the Indore Development Authority as a suburb. MR-10, the Airport Road and the Indore to Ujjain road pass through it, so it grew as both a commercial and a residential area. It is made up of colonies such as Heera Nagar, Nyay Nagar, Sunder Nagar, Shyam Nagar and Kabir Khedi, mostly plotted houses, and it borders Vijay Nagar and Schemes 54, 74 and 78.

Hira Nagar, MR 10 Road and ISBT are stations on the Indore Metro Yellow Line, which began regular service on this stretch in September 2026, so a tutor can ride the metro and walk or take an auto into the colonies. Most families live in independent houses, so the tutor goes straight to the door. MR-10 carries heavy traffic through the day, so parents often set classes for the late afternoon or after the evening peak. For senior science and maths, many families add online sessions with a specialist. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

super-corridor.name: Super Corridor
super-corridor.about:
Super Corridor is the common name for a planned road in north-west Indore linking the AB Road national highway with the Ujjain road and the airport, and the name now covers the new township belt along it. Housing is mostly residential plots, row houses and apartment projects inside gated townships, alongside large IT campuses and commercial land. The Indore Development Authority has planned housing schemes on the stretch, and MR-10 also joins it.

The Indore Metro Yellow Line runs along the corridor: its first stretch, with five stations from Devi Ahilya Bai Holkar Terminal, opened on 31 May 2025, and the Super Corridor 1 and 2 stations followed in September 2026. A tutor can use the metro and then an auto into the township, where they will usually be registered at the gate once. Many townships are still filling up, so fewer tutors live on the corridor itself and most travel in from Vijay Nagar or Sukhliya. Online classes are a practical addition for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

old-palasia.name: Old Palasia
old-palasia.about:
Old Palasia lies in the heart of Indore, on one side of AB Road, which separates it from New Palasia. It is a densely built area with independent houses, villas and apartment buildings mixed with shops, clinics and offices, and the wider Palasia area is known as an education hub with many coaching institutes. Saket Square and Sanghi Colony are close by, with Kanadia Road and Pipliyahana further east.

Palasia Square is a planned underground station on the Indore Metro Yellow Line, but it is not open yet, so for now tutors arrive by city bus, auto or two-wheeler. In the independent houses a tutor goes straight to the door, while apartment buildings may keep a visitor register. Parking near the busy squares can be tight in the evening, so families often choose a slot just after school or later in the evening. The many coaching institutes nearby mean students often want a home tutor to support school work alongside coaching. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

new-palasia.name: New Palasia
new-palasia.about:
New Palasia sits across AB Road from Old Palasia in central Indore and is one of the city's busiest mixed areas. It is home to the well-known 56 Dukan food street and has a mix of apartment buildings, independent houses, shops and offices. RS Bhandari Marg and the main Palasia area are next to it, with Race Course Road and South Tukoganj close by.

The Indore Metro Yellow Line is planned to reach Palasia Square as an underground station on its way to the railway station, but that section is not yet open, so tutors currently come by bus, auto or two-wheeler. Many families live in apartment buildings where a tutor signs in at the entrance, while in the independent houses they go directly to the door. The food street and markets draw crowds in the evenings and at weekends, so an after-school slot on weekdays is usually easier. With coaching institutes all around, many students look for a tutor who can support school subjects alongside coaching. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

race-course-road.name: Race Course Road
race-course-road.about:
Race Course Road is a central Indore locality near South Tukoganj, RS Bhandari Marg and Yashwant Niwas Road. Housing ranges from kothis and independent houses to builder floors and apartment buildings, alongside offices and clinics. New Palasia and the AB Road belt are close by.

There is no metro station here yet, though Palasia Square is planned as an underground station on the Yellow Line, so tutors travel by auto, two-wheeler or car. Most homes are independent houses or small buildings, so a tutor reaches the door directly and parking is usually manageable on the side roads. Traffic around the Palasia squares builds up in the evening, which makes an early evening class easier to keep on time. Families here often look for experienced tutors for board classes and pair them with online sessions for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

manorama-ganj.name: Manorama Ganj
manorama-ganj.about:
Manorama Ganj is a well-established residential area in central Indore, near Kanchan Bagh, Ratlam Kothi and Geeta Bhawan. It is known for its greenery and quiet lanes, with independent houses as well as apartment buildings, and it shares the 452001 postcode with the Palasia area. AB Road runs along the Geeta Bhawan side.

City buses stop within a short walk and autos are easy to find, which suits tutors coming from other parts of the city. Most families live in houses or small apartment buildings, so a tutor normally goes straight to the door. Geeta Bhawan square and AB Road get crowded in the evening, so a class that starts shortly after school tends to avoid the worst of it. The Indore Metro Yellow Line has no open station here yet; Palasia Square is planned. For board and entrance preparation, many parents combine a home tutor with online sessions from a specialist. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

geeta-bhawan.name: Geeta Bhawan
geeta-bhawan.about:
Geeta Bhawan is a central residential locality in Indore named after the Shree Geeta Bhawan temple, and the area also has hotels, clinics and a medical college campus. Housing includes IDA flats, cooperative group housing societies and a few hundred private houses, with colonies such as Kanchan Bagh, Manorama Ganj and Navratan Bagh nearby. AB Road is its main arterial road, and the main junction is known as Geeta Bhawan Square.

Indore Junction is the nearest railway station, and autos, city buses and shared vans are easy to find, so tutors from across the city can reach the area without much planning. In the societies a tutor is usually registered at the gate once, while in the private houses they go straight to the door. Geeta Bhawan Square is one of the busier junctions on AB Road in the evening, so families often keep classes to the late afternoon. Parents of senior students frequently add online sessions for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

lig-colony.name: LIG Colony
lig-colony.about:
LIG Colony is a residential locality on AB Road that was started by the Indore Development Authority. It is divided into lettered sectors of IDA houses and flats, with some later housing societies, and it lies between Palasia and Vijay Nagar, with Patnipura as another neighbour. The main junction on AB Road is known as LIG Square.

The Indore Metro Yellow Line currently ends at Malviya Nagar Chauraha on the Vijay Nagar side, and the planned extension towards Palasia is not yet open, so most tutors arrive by city bus, auto or two-wheeler along AB Road. In the IDA sectors a tutor usually goes directly to the door, while societies may keep a gate register. AB Road traffic peaks in the evening, so a class timed just after school hours is easier to sustain. Families often pair a nearby home tutor with online sessions for board and entrance preparation. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

saket-nagar.name: Saket Nagar
saket-nagar.about:
Saket Nagar is an established, mainly residential locality in south-central Indore, with apartments, independent houses and plots. It sits near Mahaveer Nagar, Tilak Nagar and Kanadia Road, and Saket Square links it with the Old Palasia side. Mahatma Gandhi Road leads towards Indore Junction railway station.

The Indore Metro does not yet serve this part of the city, so tutors come by auto, city bus or two-wheeler. Families in independent houses let the tutor straight in, while apartment buildings usually have a guard who notes visitors. The roads towards Palasia and the Eastern Ring Road get busy in the evening, so a slot just after school or after the peak works well. With many coaching institutes nearby in Palasia, parents often look for a home tutor who can reinforce school topics, and add online sessions for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

tilak-nagar.name: Tilak Nagar
tilak-nagar.about:
Tilak Nagar is a mid-income residential locality close to the centre of Indore, with apartments, mostly two-bedroom, as well as independent houses and plots. It lies near Bakhtawar Ram Nagar, Saket Nagar and Kanadia Road, and the Eastern Ring Road runs close by. The Geeta Bhawan road leads towards Indore Junction railway station.

Tutors usually reach Tilak Nagar by auto, city bus or two-wheeler, since the metro does not yet run here. In apartment buildings a tutor is usually signed in at the entrance, while in houses they go straight to the door. The Eastern Ring Road and the roads towards Geeta Bhawan are busy in the evening, so families often book a class for the late afternoon. Parents of senior students often combine a local home tutor with online sessions for maths and science. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

nipania.name: Nipania
nipania.about:
Nipania is a fast-growing residential area in north-east Indore, near Tulsi Nagar, Hare Krishna Vihar and Mahalaxmi Nagar, with Pipliya Kumar as another neighbour. It has many apartment societies and gated projects, along with builder floors, plots and independent houses. AB Road, the national highway, is close by, and the Super Corridor route leads towards the airport.

The Indore Metro Yellow Line currently ends at Malviya Nagar Chauraha, which is the nearest station on this side, so a tutor using the metro will need an auto for the last part. In the gated societies a tutor is usually registered at the gate once, which makes regular classes simple after the first visit. Roads linking Nipania with the ring road and AB Road get busy in the evening, so families often choose a slot just after school. Many parents here also use online classes for IB, IGCSE or competitive exam subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

mahalaxmi-nagar.name: Mahalaxmi Nagar
mahalaxmi-nagar.about:
Mahalaxmi Nagar lies in north-east Indore next to the Eastern Ring Road and has become a hub of high-rise apartment buildings since the 2000s, along with planned plotted layouts and wide internal roads. It borders Dewas Naka, Vijay Nagar, Malviya Nagar and Nipania, and AB Road is its main arterial road. The Mahalaxmi junction is one of the main points on the ring road.

Malviya Nagar Chauraha, the current end of the Indore Metro Yellow Line after the September 2026 extension, is in neighbouring Malviya Nagar, so a tutor can take the metro and walk or ride an auto the rest of the way. Laxmibai Nagar is the nearest railway station. In the apartment towers a tutor is registered at the gate, while in plotted lanes they reach the door directly. The ring road junctions get crowded at office closing time, so classes are often set before or after that peak. Families in the towers frequently add online sessions with specialist subject tutors. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

bicholi-mardana.name: Bicholi Mardana
bicholi-mardana.about:
Bicholi Mardana is on the eastern edge of Indore, close to the bypass road, near IDA Scheme No. 140, Bhuri Tekri and Bengali Square. It has grown as families look for homes away from the busy centre, and plots and independent houses are common, with apartment projects now coming up. Pipliyahana and Kanadia Road are also nearby.

There is no metro station here, so tutors come by city bus, auto or two-wheeler. Because many homes are independent houses on plots, a tutor usually reaches the door directly, while the newer apartment projects have gates with a visitor register. Some parts are still developing, so fewer tutors live locally and most travel in from Bengali Square, Pipliyahana or Vijay Nagar. Planning a fixed weekday slot and adding online sessions for specialist subjects makes regular study easier. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

scheme-140.name: Scheme No. 140
scheme-140.about:
Scheme No. 140 is an Indore Development Authority scheme in east Indore, near Pipliyahana, Brijeshwari Annexe and Ashish Nagar, with Bicholi Mardana and Palasia in the same part of the city. It has apartment buildings and plotted houses, and it is close to the Eastern Ring Road and the Bhopal road.

The metro does not reach this area yet, so tutors come by auto, city bus or two-wheeler, usually along the Eastern Ring Road. In apartment buildings a tutor is registered with security once, while in plotted houses they go straight to the door. The ring road and the Pipliyahana junction get busy in the evening, so many families prefer a slot just after school hours. Parents of senior students often combine a local home tutor with online classes for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

pipliyahana.name: Pipliyahana
pipliyahana.about:
Pipliyahana is a developing residential locality in south-east Indore, closely linked with Bengali Square, Vijay Nagar and Kanadia Road. It is known for planned layouts with plotted houses and apartment buildings, and the Eastern Ring Road runs past its main junction. IDA Scheme No. 140 and Scheme No. 94 are close by.

The Indore Metro does not serve Pipliyahana yet; Bengali Square is planned as a Yellow Line station. For now, tutors arrive by auto, city bus or two-wheeler. In the plotted colonies a tutor goes straight to the door, while apartment buildings usually ask visitors to sign in. The ring road junction gets crowded at office hours, so parents often set classes in the late afternoon or later in the evening. Many families use online sessions alongside a home tutor for specialist or senior subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

scheme-94.name: Scheme No. 94
scheme-94.about:
Scheme No. 94 is an Indore Development Authority scheme on the Ring Road in east Indore, near Swami Vivekanand Nagar, Manbhavan Nagar and Telephone Nagar, with Pipliyahana next to it. It is mainly residential, with IDA houses, plots and apartment buildings along planned roads.

There is no metro station here, so tutors come by city bus, auto or two-wheeler, usually along the Ring Road. In the plotted sectors a tutor reaches the door directly, while apartment buildings may keep a visitor register. The Ring Road is busy through the evening, so families find an after-school slot easier to keep regular. For senior classes and entrance preparation, many parents pair a local tutor with online classes from a subject specialist. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

khajrana.name: Khajrana
khajrana.about:
Khajrana is an older locality in east Indore, widely known for the Khajrana Ganesh Temple, which is also one of the main junctions on the Indore Ring Road. The area mixes older lanes and independent houses with newer colonies such as Ganeshpuri and apartment buildings. Ganesh Nagar, Ganeshpuri Colony and Baba Mansa Nagar are among its neighbouring pockets, and the Ujjain to Khandwa state highway passes through.

Khajrana Square is an approved station on the Indore Metro Yellow Line between Malviya Nagar and Bengali Square, but it is not open yet, so tutors currently come by bus, auto or two-wheeler. In the older lanes a tutor goes straight to the door, though parking can be limited, while apartment buildings usually keep a gate register. Crowds around the temple junction build up on festival days and weekends, so weekday classes are easier to schedule. Online sessions are a practical addition for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

kanadia-road.name: Kanadia Road
kanadia-road.about:
Kanadia Road is a residential belt in east Indore running out from the Bengali Square side, near Mahaveer Nagar, Saket Nagar and Telephone Nagar. It has apartment buildings, independent houses and plots, and the national highway, the Eastern Ring Road and Garipipliya Road link it with the rest of the city. Several business parks sit along the road.

Bengali Square is planned as a station on the Indore Metro Yellow Line, but it is not open yet, so tutors come by auto, city bus or two-wheeler. In apartment buildings a tutor is usually registered at the entrance, while in the independent houses they go straight to the door. Traffic gathers around Bengali Square and the ring road in the evening, so a class that starts shortly after school tends to run on time. Many families add online sessions for board exam and entrance subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

bhawarkua.name: Bhawarkua
bhawarkua.about:
Bhawarkua, also written Bhanwarkuan, is a busy locality in south Indore on AB Road and the Ujjain to Khandwa state highway. It has been home to university campuses since the 1950s and is now a major student hub, with many coaching institutes, hostels and rented rooms. More than fifteen sectors of houses make up the residential side, and Navlakha, Khandwa Naka and Khatiwala Tank are its neighbours.

Saifee Nagar is the nearest railway halt and Indore Junction is not far, while city buses and autos run along AB Road all day. Most homes are independent houses or small buildings, so a tutor reaches the door directly, though parking near the main square can be difficult. The area is crowded for most of the day because of the students and coaching traffic, so families often pick an early evening or late slot. Because many coaching institutes are close by, school students here often look for home tutors who can support board work alongside coaching. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sapna-sangeeta.name: Sapna Sangeeta Road
sapna-sangeeta.about:
Sapna Sangeeta Road is a busy shopping street and residential belt in south-central Indore, near Agarwal Nagar, Sneh Nagar and Vidya Nagar, with Khatiwala Tank, Sindhi Colony, Janki Nagar and Palsikar Colony around it. Homes include apartments, builder floors and plots, and there are office buildings and many shops along the road. AB Road, the Khandwa road and Navlakha Road all connect it with the rest of the city.

Indore Junction and Saifee Nagar railway stations are the nearest rail points, and city buses and autos are easy to find, which helps tutors coming from other parts of Indore. In builder floors and houses a tutor goes straight to the door, while larger apartment buildings usually keep a register. The shopping stretch gets crowded in the evening, so families often choose a class time before the market rush. Parents of senior students often add online sessions with specialist tutors. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

navlakha.name: Navlakha
navlakha.about:
Navlakha is a residential locality in Indore named after the Navlakha temple, and it is also known for the Navlakha Bus Stand, where many long-distance buses begin. The area has older houses along with a growing number of new multi-storey buildings, and a weekly Thursday market is held here. Bhawarkua is next door on AB Road, with Sapna Sangeeta Road nearby.

Autos, city buses and shared vans are easy to find because of the bus stand and AB Road, so tutors from across the city can reach Navlakha without difficulty. In older houses a tutor goes straight to the door, while the new apartment buildings usually keep a visitor register. The bus stand area and AB Road are busy in the morning and evening, so an afternoon or early evening class is easier to keep regular. Online sessions help when a student needs a specialist in a particular subject. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sudama-nagar.name: Sudama Nagar
sudama-nagar.about:
Sudama Nagar is a large, mid-income residential area in west Indore, close to the heart of the city and surrounded by other residential and commercial zones. It is made up mostly of independent houses, followed by apartments and plots, and Annapurna Road links it with the railway stations and the Rajendra Nagar side to the south. AB Road is within reach for travel across the city.

Lokmanya Nagar and Indore Junction are the nearest railway stations, reached via Annapurna Road, while city buses and autos cover the local roads. As most families live in independent houses, a tutor usually goes straight to the door, and short classes on weekdays are easy to fit in. Annapurna Road gets busy in the evening, so families often set classes soon after school. Parents of students in senior classes often combine a nearby home tutor with online sessions for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

rajendra-nagar.name: Rajendra Nagar
rajendra-nagar.about:
Rajendra Nagar is a residential area in south-west Indore that took shape from the 1960s and is known for its greenery. It has apartments and houses built by local builders, laid out in sectors, and it lies along AB Road on the way to Rau and Mhow. Bijalpur, Prabhu Nagar and the Annapurna Road side are its neighbours.

Rajendra Nagar railway station, on the Akola to Ratlam line, is in the locality, and Lokmanya Nagar station is also close, while city buses run along AB Road. In the independent houses a tutor reaches the door directly, and apartment buildings usually keep a gate register. AB Road gets busy at school and office closing times, so families often set classes a little later in the evening. Parents of students in senior classes often add online sessions for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

bijalpur.name: Bijalpur
bijalpur.about:
Bijalpur is in the south-west of Indore, near Rajendra Nagar, Dhanwantri Nagar and Prabhu Nagar. Once a farming area, it now has mid-income apartment buildings from local builders alongside independent houses, and it centres on Bijalpur Square. AB Road runs past it, and it falls in the Rau assembly constituency.

Rajendra Nagar is the nearest broad gauge railway station, and city buses run from Bijalpur Square, so tutors from the Rajendra Nagar and Annapurna Road side can reach it easily. In apartment buildings a tutor is usually signed in at the gate, while in houses they go straight to the door. AB Road is busy at school and office closing times, so families often choose a slot a little later in the evening. Many parents also use online classes for specialist or senior subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

rau.name: Rau
rau.about:
Rau is a suburb of Indore and a nagar panchayat in its own right, part of the Indore Metropolitan Region. It sits on AB Road, the national highway, between Rajendra Nagar and Mhow, and the road to the Pithampur industrial area branches off here. Housing ranges from the older town to newer plotted colonies and apartment projects, including the Silicon City area.

Rau railway station on the Akola to Ratlam line serves the suburb, and frequent city buses link it with Indore, Mhow and Pithampur. In plotted colonies a tutor goes straight to the door, while newer gated projects register visitors at the gate. Fewer tutors live in Rau itself, so many travel in from Rajendra Nagar or the city, and AB Road traffic is heavier at school and office closing times, which is worth keeping in mind when fixing a slot. Online sessions work well for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

silicon-city.name: Silicon City
silicon-city.about:
Silicon City is a residential locality in the Rau area of south-west Indore, close to AB Road and the Rau to Pithampur road. It is a mid-income area with apartments and plotted houses, and pockets such as Saptshrangi Nagar, Tulsi Parisar and Sector B, with Pulak City, Shiv City and Nihalpur Mundi as neighbours.

Rajendra Nagar and Rau railway stations are the nearest rail points, and city buses run along AB Road, so a tutor coming by public transport usually finishes by auto. In apartment blocks a tutor is registered at the gate once, while in the plotted pockets they reach the door directly. AB Road gets busy at school and office closing times, so a slightly later evening class is often smoother. Families here frequently add online sessions for senior maths and science. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

Vijay Nagar & AB Road.fact: The first priority corridor of the Indore Metro Yellow Line, with five stations from Devi Ahilya Bai Holkar Terminal to Veerangana Jhalkari Bai along the Super Corridor, entered service on 31 May 2025.

Priority corridor 2, from Super Corridor 2 to Malviya Nagar Chauraha with eleven stations including MR 10 Road, ISBT, Hira Nagar, Bapat Chauraha, Meghdoot Garden and Vijay Nagar Chauraha, was inaugurated on 5 September 2026, with regular service from 6 September 2026.
After the September 2026 opening, Indore Metro has 16 operational stations on about 17 km of the Yellow Line.
Kushabhau Thakre Marg, commonly known as the Super Corridor, links the Agra to Mumbai national highway (AB Road) with MP State Highway 27 and Indore airport.
Vijay Nagar was developed by the Indore Development Authority and lies between MR-9, MR-10 and the Eastern Ring Road.
Sukhliya was developed by the Indore Municipal Corporation and the Indore Development Authority, with MR-10, the Airport Road and the Indore to Ujjain road passing through it.
Indore's BRTS (iBus) began operating on 10 May 2013, with an AB Road pilot corridor; the dedicated corridor has since been dismantled on the direction of the Madhya Pradesh High Court.

Palasia & Central Indore.fact: AB Road (the old National Highway 3) separates Old Palasia and New Palasia; Palasia is known as an education hub with many coaching institutes.
Palasia Square is an approved underground station on the Indore Metro Yellow Line, which is planned to continue to Indore Railway Station, Rajwada and the airport.
The Yellow Line is planned to extend from Malviya Nagar Chauraha via Bengali Chauraha, Patrakar Colony and Palasia to the railway station.
In February 2025 the Madhya Pradesh High Court ordered removal of the BRTS corridor between Rajiv Gandhi Square and Dewas Naka on AB Road, citing increased traffic.
LIG Colony was started by the Indore Development Authority and is divided into lettered sectors; AB Road is its arterial road.
Geeta Bhawan has IDA flats, cooperative group housing societies and private houses; its main junction on AB Road is Geeta Bhawan Square and the nearest railway station is Indore Junction.

Nipania, Bicholi & Ring Road.fact: The Indore Ring Road is a six-lane road built by the Indore Development Authority.
Major junctions on the Ring Road include Mahalaxmi, Malviya Nagar, Khajrana Ganesh Temple, Bengali Square, World Cup Square, IT Park and Rajiv Gandhi Square.
The Ring Road has flyovers at Bengali Square, World Cup Square and Teen Imli Square.
Malviya Nagar Chauraha became the eastern end of the operational Yellow Line when priority corridor 2 opened in September 2026.
Mumtaj Bag Colony, Khajrana Square, Bengali Square and Patrakar Colony are approved, not yet open, stations on the Yellow Line beyond Malviya Nagar Chauraha.
Mahalaxmi lies in the north-east of the city next to the Eastern Ring Road and has become a hub of high-rise buildings; its neighbours include Dewas Naka, Vijay Nagar and Malviya Nagar.

Bhawarkua, Rajendra Nagar & Rau.fact: Rau is a suburb of Indore and a nagar panchayat on National Highway 52 (AB Road) between Mhow and Rajendra Nagar; the road to Pithampur branches off at Rau.
Rau railway station is on the Akola to Ratlam line.
Rajendra Nagar railway station is the nearest broad gauge station for Bijalpur in south-west Indore.
Bhanwarkuan lies on AB Road (NH 52) and the Ujjain to Khandwa road (MP SH 27), and has hosted a university campus since 1956.
Saifee Nagar is the nearest railway halt for Bhanwarkuan, with Indore Junction the main station.
Navlakha is named after the Navlakha temple and has the Navlakha Bus Stand, the starting point of many long-distance bus services.
